summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 12,170,970 ordinary shares on April 24, 2026, as part of its existing buyback programme announced January 30, 2026. Shares were bought from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 97.6987 pence. The company intends to cancel the purchased shares. This is a routine open-market buyback under an existing program, not a tender offer. The filing is an ordinary capital return transaction; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for continued execution of the buyback program as a capital return signal to shareholders.
